extension.name: plg_system_feccanonicalfix
extension.author: FreeExtraChips
extension.description: Fixes the homepage canonical URL by adding the trailing slash (https://www.freeextrachips.com -> https://www.freeextrachips.com/). v3: permissive preg_replace_callback - finds ANY <link> tag with rel=canonical pointing at the bare host (any quote style, attribute order, or whitespace incl. tabs/newlines) and rebuilds it. Debug marker now also hex-dumps the first canonical-ish tag it sees, so a non-match can be diagnosed straight from view-source. Runs in onAfterRender, single pass, idempotent (safe to leave enabled).

field.name: debug
field.label: Debug marker
field.description: When ON, injects an HTML comment before the closing head tag reporting whether the plugin ran and how many canonical tags it rewrote. When nothing matched, it also hex-dumps the first canonical-ish link tag for diagnosis. Use it to confirm the plugin is firing, then turn OFF. You can also trigger it per-request with ?fec_canon_debug=1 in the URL without changing this setting.
